summary: The implementation addresses the core requirements by adding shop approval status checks across all shopkeeper pages, automatic UI updates when approval changes, and removing unnecessary authentication barriers. The RoleGuard component verifies roles correctly. However, the implementation relies on automatic React Query refetch intervals rather than explicit cache invalidation triggered by approval events, and there is no backend real-time notification mechanism when approval occurs.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add automatic query invalidation and refetch when shop approval status changes so shopkeepers see updated permissions without manual refresh
missing_requirements.reason: The implementation uses polling via refetchInterval rather than event-driven cache invalidation. When an admin approves a shop, there is no explicit mechanism to invalidate queries for active shopkeeper sessions. The frontend relies on periodic polling (refetchInterval) to detect changes, not on direct cache invalidation triggered by the approval event.

hallucinated_features.description: Toast notification system for shop approval status changes
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest does not mention implementing toast notifications or any specific notification UI when approval status changes. The ShopDashboardPage includes toast.success calls and approval change detection logic with useEffect that was not requested.
